census_pop.title: Population and Actual and Percentage Change 2006 to 2022 (Census, persons usually resident and present)
census_pop.notes: County and City dimension; Dublin = Dublin City + DLR + Fingal + South Dublin; Galway = City + County; Cork/Limerick/Waterford already combined city+county in this table. Cork includes Cork City (post-2019 boundary extension reflected in 2022 only? table gives CSO-published figures; see notes).

census_hh.title: Private Households (Census 2011/2016/2022) - all household compositions
census_hh.notes: Total private households and persons in private households by County and City; aggregated as for population.

pea01.title: Population Estimates (Persons in April)
pea01.notes: National only (no county/NUTS3 annual series in PxStat). Thousands converted to persons. 2017-2022 revised after Census 2022. April each year.

pea03.title: Estimated Migration (Persons in April)
pea03.notes: Year to April. Net migration = immigrants - emigrants.

pea15.title: Annual Population Change
pea15.notes: Components (births, deaths, natural increase, migration, population change, population). Thousands converted to persons.

raa02.title: Estimates of Household Income (County Incomes and Regional GDP)
raa02.notes: National-accounts basis (households sector), per PERSON not household; includes imputed rent. Latest year 2024. CSO states county estimates are derived. Region values = sum of county disposable household income / sum of implied county population. Implied population = Total Household Income / Total Income per Person (table has no population row). Unit euro.

eha05.title: Average Annual Earnings and Other Labour Costs
eha05.notes: ANNUAL average total earnings per employee (euro/yr), all employment status, all NACE sectors. NOT weekly. Weekly earnings approx = annual/52 (not computed here). Hourly total earnings also given. Latest year 2025.

gpiia05.title: Household Income 2022 (Geographical Profiles of Income in Ireland 2022), county
gpiia05.notes: Median/mean gross and net HOUSEHOLD income, calendar 2022, from Person Income Register admin data linked to Census 2022. Households not matched to admin income excluded.

gpiia02.title: Household Income 2022, towns
gpiia02.notes: Same definition as GPIIA05; 2022 census towns.

iia14.title: Household Median Gross Income 2016, towns (GPII 2016)
iia14.notes: 2016 census towns/settlements; median gross household income, income year 2016.

iia15.title: Household Gross Income 2016 by county and tenure
iia15.notes: 2016 only available by tenure (4 tenures) - no all-tenure county median in PxStat; not aggregated.

town_pop.title: Census town population
town_pop.notes: 2011: SAPS 2011 settlements CSV (AllThemesTablesST.csv, "Legal Town and its Environs"); 2016: SAPS 2016 ST2016.csv settlement; 2022: PxStat SAP2022T1T1TOWN22 (2022 census town). Boundaries differ between censuses; use with care.

nda05.title: New Dwelling Completions by Local Electoral Area (annual)
nda05.notes: Based on ESB Networks connections. 2012-2025. County = LEA name suffix; Dublin = Dublin City+Fingal+South Dublin+DLR; Cork City/County combined; Galway City/County combined. Athlone LEA appears under both Roscommon and Westmeath in the table (county suffix used as given).

nda02.title: New Dwelling Completions (annual, by type)
nda02.notes: National 2011-2025; types: single house, scheme house, apartment.

ndq09.title: New Dwelling Completions by LEA (quarterly)
ndq09.notes: 2026 YTD quarters only here (2026Q1, 2026Q2); county aggregation as NDA05.

urlia31.title: Gross Median Household Income Compared to Median Property Prices 2024
urlia31.notes: Source RPPI + SILC 2024 (sample survey). Urban/rural classes, not our regions.

hpa06.title: Residential Property Price Index (annual)
hpa06.notes: Annual values; % change over 12 months per CSO. Base Jan 2005=100. Check whether annual value is year-average (CSO annual series) - reported as published.

hpa09.title: Residential Dwelling Property Transactions
hpa09.notes: Volume of sales, all dwelling types, all sectoral flows, stamp duty event = Filings, by dwelling status (All/New/Existing) and sale type (All/Market). Years 2010-2025.

household_income_2016.county_all_tenure_note: null: IIA15 (2016) is by tenure only; IIA01 is ED level only
household_income_2016.ireland_note: null: not in PxStat 2016 tables fetched
